question: Who among the following was nominated for the Saraswati Samman, 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sharankumar Limbale.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr Sharan Kumar Limbale has bagged the Saraswati Samman, the country's highest literary award, for year 2020 for his Marathi novel 'Sanaatan'__ published in 2018.
 
• He is the former head of Nashik's Yashwantrao Chavan Open University and the author of 40 books.
 
• He is the first Dalit writer to get the award.
 
• The award carries a cash prize of Rs 15 lakh and a citation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Noted poet and litterateur Prof Ramdarash Mishra was awarded the prestigious Saraswati Samman, 2021, for his collection of poems ‘Mein to Yahan Hun’.
